definitions.explanation: A craftsperson whose trade is sharpening and polishing blades such as kitchen knives, scissors, or Japanese swords, using whetstones. The sword-polishing specialist is a highly skilled traditional craftsman.

examples.japanese: {研|と}ぎ{師|し}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{包丁|ほうちょう}→包丁：04976_houchou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{頼|たの}んだ→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧。
examples.english: I asked a sharpener to do my kitchen knife.

examples.japanese: {研|と}ぎ{師|し}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{刃物|はもの}→刃物：11752_hamono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦きれい→きれい：00717_kirei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{研|と}いだ→研ぐ：04377_togu⟧。
examples.english: The sharpener sharpened the blade beautifully.

examples.japanese: ⟦{刀|かたな}→刀：02194_katana⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{研|と}ぎ{師|し}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{修業|しゅぎょう}→修業：16906_shugyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: Becoming a sword polisher requires long years of training.

notes:
From ⟦{研|と}ぐ→研ぐ：04377_togu⟧ (to sharpen, to whet) + {師|し} (a master of a craft). Covers everyday knife and scissor sharpeners as well as the specialist ⟦{刀|かたな}→刀：02194_katana⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{研|と}ぎ{師|し} (sword polisher).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{包丁|ほうちょう}→包丁：04976_houchou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{研|と}ぎ{師|し}: a kitchen-knife sharpener
- ⟦{刀|かたな}→刀：02194_katana⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{研|と}ぎ{師|し}: a Japanese-sword polisher
- {研|と}ぎ{師|し}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧: to send (a blade) to a sharpener

CULTURAL NOTE:
Sword polishing (⟦{刀剣|とうけん}→刀剣：23020_touken⟧⟦{研磨|けんま}→研磨：15434_kenma⟧) is a recognized traditional craft; the polisher not only sharpens the edge but reveals the blade's grain and temper line.
